_comment: Spoken-line manifest for The Late Market. Source of truth for the Friday bake. Every entry mirrors a deps.say() call site exactly — `text` is the DISPLAY text (what the player reads); spokenText defaults to text (no acting tags in v1 so word-level alignment stays clean). `variants` expands template placeholders into baked line ids. Runtime lookup is by normalized display text.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: Day one. Till £1,200. Quayline's £2,000 bill lands Day 4. Something on the ledger is already bleeding.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: The shutters were left open. Day {day} of 5 — the books remember where you stopped.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: Let's look at what you did with that pair. Not what a textbook would do. What you did.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: You chased both times. Good. But notice how the same choice felt different when both ends sat further out.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: 1 of the two was deferred (Day 3) — the frame, not the facts, did the work.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: 1 of the two was deferred (Day 5) — the frame, not the facts, did the work.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: 2 of the two was deferred (Day 3 and Day 5) — the frame, not the facts, did the work.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: Deferral is not always a trap.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: Here's the rule. Say it until it's boring.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: The Claims Desk in the market buys settling. They open every negotiation with their number. Notice whose number is already on the table.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: Collector at the end of the row. Careful — he buys the customer with the debt.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: Three runs. One invoice. Did your minimum move with their opening?

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: The facts never moved. The opening number did.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: You never named a floor. The anchor had nothing to push against — which is its own answer: decide the number before their number arrives.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: Flip it. Open with the law, not with their number.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: Mareline. Three years a customer, sixty days late, four times a year. Now silence.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: Word travels. Two offers found your door already.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: Look at what you paid while nobody answered. Then look again — as if the account were brand new.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: History is a fact. It is not a reason.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: Market close. This is the street your decisions built.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: Let's read what you actually did — not what a textbook would do.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: Three numbers, computed from your own choices. Not a diagnosis — a mirror.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: Finally — the ledger the street keeps.

lines.speaker: factor
lines.text: Aged on your desk, did it? Good. I will pay you for the days you lost — the rest is mine.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I buy the customer with the debt still on it. You keep the invoice; I keep the account.

lines.speaker: shark
lines.text: A little cash now, a little back each day. The daily number is small on purpose. Is it not?

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: There it is — the full face, on your till, not the street's.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: Noted. The street thanks you — literally.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: Nobody owns a piece of your week now. Quayline is paid.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: First sitting. The desk slides a number across — no greeting. Numbers first.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Second sitting. A different number. Same desk, same silence.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Last sitting. The desk slides its final number across.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: Still no reply. The line of credit is £60 open on the shelf, and doing nothing has to travel somewhere.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: Still silence. The shelf keeps score.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: Third knock, nothing. Decide what the silence is worth.

lines.speaker: factor
lines.text: No waiting. Today’s money, today — that is the whole of my offer.

lines.speaker: shark
lines.text: A little now. A little each day. The daily number is small — that is rather the point.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: Chapter Two. The Offer. Everyone names a price first — except you.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: Chapter Three. Good money after bad. The street remembers what you already spent.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: The week closes. Let's see what your patience was worth.

lines.speaker: shark
lines.text: That old debt of yours — the one from before your week. I'll take it off your hands. 70% of face, settled off the books.

lines.speaker: shark
lines.text: Pleasure doing business. The street thanks you — literally.

lines.speaker: shark
lines.text: Your loss. The street keeps its own books.

lines.speaker: shark
lines.text: Eighty-five? Cute. Seventy, off the books, tonight — or nothing.

lines.speaker: factor
lines.text: You look like someone who'd rather have it today. I can make that happen — for a price.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: سوقان. أسبوع واحد. قانونان مختلفان.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: السوق. الأسبوع نفسه، لكن قانون مختلف — شروطك أنت تحدد ثمن التأخير، والزكاة تنتظر ما لا تحصّله أبدًا.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: والسوق يحتفظ بدفتر آخر: الزكاة على ما لا يزال مستحقًا لك. اثنان ونصف بالمئة — مستحقة سواء سُدِّدت الفاتورة أم لا.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: اليوم الأول. الخزينة فيها 5,760 درهمًا. فاتورة كوايلين البالغة 9,600 درهم تستحق في اليوم الرابع. هناك شيء في الدفتر ينزف بالفعل.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: هذه هي القاعدة. ردّدها حتى تصبح مملة.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: مكتب التسوية في السوق يشتري الاتفاق. يفتحون كل تفاوض برقمهم. لاحظ أي رقم صار على الطاولة بالفعل.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: اقلبها. ابدأ بشروطك، لا برقمهم.

lines.speaker: zana
lines.text: ماريلاين. ثلاث سنوات كعميلة، متأخرة ستون يومًا، أربع مرات في السنة. والآن صمت.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: ظلت الزكاة تتراكم على ما لم تحصّله طوال الأسبوع. السوق يحسب ما نسيه الصندوق.

lines.speaker: siki
lines.text: إغلاق السوق. هذا هو الشارع الذي بنتْه قراراتك.
